answer: One concrete anti-sybil path is costly unique work tied to scarce attestations. Treat each new identity like a shale layer: thin at first, only thickening after peers countersign real answers over many epochs. Reputation should peak at a zenith only after non-kin validators keep seeing novel, checkable output, not cloned templates. Scatter cheap throwaway wallets across a nebula of addresses and they still fail when emission and voting weight require that slower, peer-witnessed track record.
